game.name: Outlast
game.rules:
### General Rules

Full video proof with audible in-game audio is required for all submissions. Videos with extreme lag or frame drops will not be accepted.

The autosave notification ("Saving...") in the bottom left needs to be completely visible throughout the entire run.

The level must be fully loaded and visible before moving when you begin the run and you're not allowed to look around before moving to begin the run (For example, to face the gate door).

Load screen assisted jumps (AKA Enterhops) are not allowed to be used to begin a run. If it's unclear if Enterhops were used to start a run, it will be rejected.

"Jump" may NOT be bound to "Scroll Wheel Up or Scroll Wheel Down"

Framerate switching and lag abusing strategies are not allowed

All runs in the top 3 need to show FPS on the screen using the in game FPS counter. To achieve that you can see how to [bind a key to show fps in this guide](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guide/s6jr2)

Due to a community held vote, spamming crouch to skip cutscenes (I.E Jeremy Skip) is banned in main categories.

----

### Timing

Timing is done using the community made autosplitter/load remover which uses Time Without Loads (LRT). For help using the autosplitter/load remover, read [THIS GUIDE - CLICK ME](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guide/a2f0e)

If you are on PC and do not use the LRT your run will not have the loading screens manually removed, and will be verified as RTA. Loading screens are manually removed by moderators on console runs

Timing for Main Game:

Timing starts on first input after leaving Miles jeep in Administration Block. Timing ends when Miles hand touches the floor for the first time during the final cinematic in Underground Lab.

Timing for Whistleblower:

Timing starts on first input after the cell door opens in Hospital. You should start from the autosave it gives you when the cell opens but if you aren't starting from the autosave you need to get yourself into a position where you would be if you loaded the save. Timing ends when Waylon's hand touches the car handle on Miles' jeep in Exit

---

### Bhops

Bhopping is attempting to consistently get frame perfect jumps in a row, while being on the ground.

As of February 9th 2022, bhopping is banned from all full game categories on PC.

The only exceptions to this rule are :

- **"Unintentional bhops"** (as long as they are consistent on 62FPS).
Those are the bhops you can easily get without going for it because doing a jump is faster, regardless if you get a bhop or not.

- **"Strat Bhops"** (as long as they are consistent on 62FPS).
All bhops that are part of a strat are allowed. A bhop is considered a "strat bhop" if the timesave you get is not only due to the fact that bhopping is faster than running.

More information about bhop rules and examples can be found [here](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guides/j73iw).

All bhops are allowed on console.

---

### Game Modification

Modifying the configuration files, adding new configuration files, and using 3rd party tools that interfere with the game (Cheat Engine, Unreal Engine Mod Loaders, ect.) are not allowed.

However, there are a few exceptions:

- You are allowed to disable Steam integration. [Read this guide for more information](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guide/timyh)
- You are allowed to change "bPauseOnLossOfFocus=TRUE" in OLEngine.ini from TRUE to false to allow tabbing out of the game without it pausing in windowed mode. DON'T USE IN FULLSCREEN
- You are allowed to delete or rename "IntroLogo.bik" in \Outlast\OLGame\Config\Movies to skip the intro movie
- You are allowed to change "bEnableMouseSmoothing=TRUE" in DefaultInput.ini from TRUE to false
- Russian, Turkish and Hungarian fan language patches are allowed to be installed, however we really don't recommend using them as they are unsupported by Red Barrels.

----

### Additional Notes

Any major glitches, strats, and other various timesaves unknown to the community must be shared for everyone to use before the run will be verified. The strat in question must also be verified to work on everyone else's computer or consoles.

Although very rare, the moderation team may request additional proof to help with the verification process if its deemed necessary. Things we may request include:

- Split Files 
- Hand Cameras 
- Entire Attempt Sessions, Potentially Across Multiple Sessions 
- Local Recordings 

Its recommended that you keep these things and any additional proof handy with you before your run gets verified, incase we request it. If you have any additional questions, please reach out to a moderator in our Discord server.

relatedGames.name: Outlast Category Extensions
relatedGames.rules:
### General Rules

Full video proof with audible in-game audio is required for all submissions. You may still play your own music however it may not overpower the in-game audio. Videos with extreme lag or frame drops will not be accepted.

Any major glitches, strats, and other various timesaves unknown to the community must be shared for everyone to use before the run will be verified. The strat in question must also be verified to work on everyone else's computer or consoles.

**No modification of .ini / configuration files** unless otherwise stated by category rules unless you are enabling checkpoint names / debug tools, even if you deem them insignificant. This includes changing things such as your field of view and changing the FPS cap. Debug tools may not be used during the run, only for practice purposes.

As of February 9th 2022, all runs in the top 15 need to show FPS on the screen using the in game FPS counter. To achieve that you can see how to [bind a key to show fps in this guide](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guide/s6jr2)

You may not begin the run with a S+Q

The "Saving..." icon in the bottom left needs to be completely visible throughout the entire run.

The level must be fully loaded and visible before moving when you begin the run and you're not allowed to look around before moving to begin the run (For example, to face the gate door).

Load screen assisted jumps (AKA Enterhops) are not allowed to be used to begin a run. If it's unclear if Enterhops were used to start a run, it will be rejected. You are however allowed and encouraged to use Enterhops after the run has began.

Due to the way Twitch handles VODs, submissions from Twitch MUST be submitted as a highlight. You can find this in your Video Producer on Twitch.

Lag abusing strategies are strictly banned. This rule applies for every platform, not just PC.

Any glitches or in-game strategies that require prerun preparation are banned.

"Jump" may NOT be bound to any other key on your keyboard or mouse button other than "Spacebar"

---

### Bhops

Bhopping is attempting to consistently get frame perfect jumps in a row, while being on the ground.

As of February 9th 2022, bhopping is banned from all full game categories on PC.

The only exceptions to this rule are :

- **"Unintentional bhops"** (as long as they are consistent on 62FPS).
Those are the bhops you can easily get without going for it because doing a jump is faster, regardless if you get a bhop or not.

- **"Strat Bhops"** (as long as they are consistent on 62FPS).
All bhops that are part of a strat are allowed. A bhop is considered a "strat bhop" if the timesave you get is not only due to the fact that bhopping is faster than running.

More information about bhop rules and examples can be found [here](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guides/j73iw).

All bhops are allowed on console.

The only category that allows all bhops is the Scrollwheel category.

The following categories have a "bhop" sub category that allows all bhops and changing your fps cap to 61.81 :


- 10 Batteries
- Death
- Wheelchair to Heaven 
- FAC



---

### Timing

Timing is done using the community made autosplitter/load remover which uses Time Without Loads (LRT). The autosplitter/load remover is integrated into Livesplit, and it should give you the option to activate it if you type in Outlast under "game name".

If you are on console, you may submit without the LRT and we will retime it. If you are on PC and do not use the LRT your run will not have the loading screens manually removed. Manually pausing the timer also counts as not using the LRT.

For help setting up the autosplitter/load remover, refer to [this guide](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guide/a2f0e)

Timing for Main Game:

Timing starts at the beginning of the first chapter, when you first gain control of Miles when he leaves his jeep and ends when Miles' hand first touches the floor at the beginning of the end cutscene, before he gets shot by the soldiers.

Timing for Whistleblower:

Timing starts at the beginning of Hospital (Chapter 2), when the cell door is opened (you can load the checkpoint that's triggered as the door opens. If you're not loading, get yourself to a point where you would be spawned after loading the game) and ends when Park's left hand first touches the car door at the end of the game.

---

### Additional Notes

Although very rare, the moderation team may request additional proof to help with the verification process if its deemed necessary. Things we may request include:

- Split Files 
- Hand Cameras 
- Entire Attempt Sessions, Potentially Across Multiple Sessions 
- Local Recordings 

Its recommended that you keep these things and any additional proof handy with you before your run gets verified, incase we request it. If you have any additional questions, please reach out to a moderator in our Discord server.

categories.name: No OoB Insane
categories.rules:
`Read the 'Game Rules' tab for rules that apply to every category to ensure your submission does not get rejected for missing requirements`

---

##### No Out of Bounds Insane 

- Complete the game. 
- You must be on the Insane Difficulty. You can set a command(set OLGame DifficultyMode EDM_Insane) to change the game's difficulty before the run starts, instead of watching the whole start cutscenes. Althought, you are allowed to reload your batteries once for Main Game, and you aren't allowed to reload your batteries for WhistleBlower. 
- You are not allowed to unload the level. 
- It is considered out of bounds if the screen goes black and unloads some objects temporarily.
- Your hitbox must stay in the bounding boxes of the level

---

#### Additional Information

- Must reach one checkpoint for each chapter
- The "Saving..." icon area in the bottom left must be visible throught the entire run.

- Complete the chapter
- Usage of any glitch is allowed.

- Time starts on first input with the exception of Prison Block. For Prison Block, timing begins when the loading screen finishes.

values.name: Main Game
values.rules:
`Read the 'Game Rules' tab for rules that apply to every category to ensure your submission does not get rejected for missing requirements`

---

#### Glitchless 

Complete the game without the following strategies:

- Doorhopping (Getting on top of a doors hitbox)

- Doorclipping (Making solid doors non-solid, or clipping through doors collision)

- Wallriding (Shrinking your hitbox by using a door or vault object)

- Out of Bounds, regardless of how it is done. You can tell you’re Out of Bounds if the screen turns black and some objects unload temporarily.

- Skip animations by crouching (Animation cancels)

- Skip shimmying across ledges by jumping across them or looking back while running (Ledgerunning)

Runners may also not:

- Quit the main menu and reload your current checkpoint (S+Q) to skip cutscenes or to save warp forward. If you would like to do this, submit to Glitchless S+Q instead. 

- Skip climbing the scaffolding before entering the asylum

- Manipulate Chris to see you sooner than intended in Admin Block

- Skip the knockback animation from Chris in the security room in Admin Block after the scene where the power gets turned off

- Skipping the beginning of prison by going on the railing and jumping past the first part before decontamination (mostly referred to as Prison Jump in the community)

- Skip the showers dialogue in the Prison chapter by dodging the hit from the twin. You must travel between the two windows.

- Do Chris manip after the explosion.

- Skip the part where you're supposed to crouch in the cells by jumping.

- Skip climbing down the ladders in Sewers

- Jump on top of the barbed wires in the Courtyard 

-  Jump over the falling floor in Female Ward once reaching the 3rd floor. You must fall down and trigger the scripted scene with the Wallrider.

- Climb up the side of the stairs in the theater in Return to Admin

- Jump through the door that a variant closes on the 3rd floor in Return to Admin

- Jump on top of the railings during the long staircase in Underground Lab on your way to pull the cables (Commonly referred to in the community as “Stairs Strat”).

- Perform Superman Jump after pulling the cables in Underground Lab 

- Skip the cutscene where Miles falls up the stairs at the very end of the game by climbing over the railing

Runners must also trigger every scripted scene in the game.

values.name: Whistleblower
values.rules:
`Read the 'Game Rules' tab for rules that apply to every category to ensure your submission does not get rejected for missing requirements`

---

#### Glitchless

Complete the game without the following strategies:

`Read the 'Game Rules' tab for rules that apply to every category to ensure your submission does not get rejected for missing requirements`

---

### Glitchless (Individual Level) Rules and Restrictions

- Complete the chapter
- Read glitchless full game rules for what is and is not allowed

---

### Timing

- Time starts on first input with the exception of Prison Block. For Prison Block, timing begins when the loading screen finishes.

- Time ends when you reach any checkpoint in the next chapter, or, if you are doing Underground Lab / Exit. Time ends When Miles hand touches the floor / when Waylon's hand touches the car door.

---

### Individual Level Specific Rules

The Default sub category follows the same bhop rules as full game runs.

All bhops are allowed in the Bhop sub category, and you are allowed to cap your framerate to 61.81 FPS (bhops are significantly more consistent on 61.81).

IL runs that attempt bhops must show controls in the main menu settings at the end of the run.

Console runners should submit to the Default sub category.

games.name: Outlast
games.rules:
### General Rules

Full video proof with audible in-game audio is required for all submissions. Videos with extreme lag or frame drops will not be accepted.

The autosave notification ("Saving...") in the bottom left needs to be completely visible throughout the entire run.

The level must be fully loaded and visible before moving when you begin the run and you're not allowed to look around before moving to begin the run (For example, to face the gate door).

Load screen assisted jumps (AKA Enterhops) are not allowed to be used to begin a run. If it's unclear if Enterhops were used to start a run, it will be rejected.

"Jump" may NOT be bound to "Scroll Wheel Up or Scroll Wheel Down"

Framerate switching and lag abusing strategies are not allowed

All runs in the top 3 need to show FPS on the screen using the in game FPS counter. To achieve that you can see how to [bind a key to show fps in this guide](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guide/s6jr2)

Due to a community held vote, spamming crouch to skip cutscenes (I.E Jeremy Skip) is banned in main categories.

----

### Timing

Timing is done using the community made autosplitter/load remover which uses Time Without Loads (LRT). For help using the autosplitter/load remover, read [THIS GUIDE - CLICK ME](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guide/a2f0e)

If you are on PC and do not use the LRT your run will not have the loading screens manually removed, and will be verified as RTA. Loading screens are manually removed by moderators on console runs

Timing for Main Game:

Timing starts on first input after leaving Miles jeep in Administration Block. Timing ends when Miles hand touches the floor for the first time during the final cinematic in Underground Lab.

Timing for Whistleblower:

Timing starts on first input after the cell door opens in Hospital. You should start from the autosave it gives you when the cell opens but if you aren't starting from the autosave you need to get yourself into a position where you would be if you loaded the save. Timing ends when Waylon's hand touches the car handle on Miles' jeep in Exit

---

### Bhops

Bhopping is attempting to consistently get frame perfect jumps in a row, while being on the ground.

As of February 9th 2022, bhopping is banned from all full game categories on PC.

The only exceptions to this rule are :

- **"Unintentional bhops"** (as long as they are consistent on 62FPS).
Those are the bhops you can easily get without going for it because doing a jump is faster, regardless if you get a bhop or not.

- **"Strat Bhops"** (as long as they are consistent on 62FPS).
All bhops that are part of a strat are allowed. A bhop is considered a "strat bhop" if the timesave you get is not only due to the fact that bhopping is faster than running.

More information about bhop rules and examples can be found [here](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guides/j73iw).

All bhops are allowed on console.

---

### Game Modification

Modifying the configuration files, adding new configuration files, and using 3rd party tools that interfere with the game (Cheat Engine, Unreal Engine Mod Loaders, ect.) are not allowed.

However, there are a few exceptions:

- You are allowed to disable Steam integration. [Read this guide for more information](https://www.speedrun.com/outlast/guide/timyh)
- You are allowed to change "bPauseOnLossOfFocus=TRUE" in OLEngine.ini from TRUE to false to allow tabbing out of the game without it pausing in windowed mode. DON'T USE IN FULLSCREEN
- You are allowed to delete or rename "IntroLogo.bik" in \Outlast\OLGame\Config\Movies to skip the intro movie
- You are allowed to change "bEnableMouseSmoothing=TRUE" in DefaultInput.ini from TRUE to false
- Russian, Turkish and Hungarian fan language patches are allowed to be installed, however we really don't recommend using them as they are unsupported by Red Barrels.

----

### Additional Notes

Any major glitches, strats, and other various timesaves unknown to the community must be shared for everyone to use before the run will be verified. The strat in question must also be verified to work on everyone else's computer or consoles.

Although very rare, the moderation team may request additional proof to help with the verification process if its deemed necessary. Things we may request include:

- Split Files 
- Hand Cameras 
- Entire Attempt Sessions, Potentially Across Multiple Sessions 
- Local Recordings 

Its recommended that you keep these things and any additional proof handy with you before your run gets verified, incase we request it. If you have any additional questions, please reach out to a moderator in our Discord server.

- Wallriding (Shrinking your hitbox by using a door or vault object)

- Buttbounces (Jumping in a crouched position, as it is faster than running)

- Out of Bounds, regardless of how it is done. You can tell you’re Out of Bounds if the screen turns black and some objects unload temporarily.

- Skip animations by crouching (Animation cancels)

- Skip shimmying across ledges by jumping across them or looking back while running (Ledgerunning)

Runners may also not:

- Quit the main menu and reload your current checkpoint (S+Q) to skip cutscenes or to save warp forward. If you would like to do this, submit to Glitchless S+Q instead. 

- Skip the jumpscare in Hospital where the enemy bashes his head against the wall

Runners must also trigger every scripted scene in the game.

#Additional Notes

You need to show all Documents and Notes at the end of the run. (You can do this by pulling up your notepad after the run has been completed, before the credits have rolled.)

PC runners are allowed to use the autosplitter to track how many documents and notes they have collected. If you choose to do this, you still need to show all documents and notes at the end of the run.
